rius.description: Explain that a written procedure is worthwhile when shared clarity and repeatable guidance would materially improve the work enough to justify documenting and maintaining it, while preserving justified flexibility where needed.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Explain that a written procedure is worthwhile when shared clarity and repeatable guidance would materially improve the work enough to justify documenting and maintaining it, while preserving justified flexibility where needed.
